I don't know if the mod is compatible with other mods.
[/size]
[/b][b]About mod:
[/b]
[size=3]Kel will first appear in the event at the bus stop after bus fix.[/size]
The mod adds several custom locations that can be reached by bus.
Also makes some changes to Leia's events in which Kel takes part.

[size=3]Schedule:[/size]
[size=3]On Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, almost the whole day on his job.[/size]
[size=3]On Tuesday until 15 o'clock he is in the office, then in a small park at the bottom of the location with his house until 19 o'clock when he returns home.[/size]
[size=3]On weekends, he spends all day at home, but when a player gets 2 hearts with him, he begins to come to the valley, where he can be found in the library and saloon.
[/size]
[size=4][b]Known issues:[/b]
Access to his room is available regardless of the level of friendship.
The event at the bus stop may not work if you are playing in multiplayer.
The schedule will not work properly if you are using SVE.
[/size][size=4]The patio is not working.

[/size]Development Plans:
Adding an English translation.(in the next update)
Compatibility with other mods such as SVE, RSV and ZuzuCity. (probably in the next update)
The ability to choose vanilla styled portraits with config file, more portraits in dialogues and events. (probably in the next update)
Adding patio, new locations, antisocial NPCs, events, animations and dialogue lines. 
Adding dialogue lines to other characters, including Leah and changing her events. 
Adding more seasonal outfits.
